title: Ford's new NSA intelligence system

tellings.quote: But first of all, we want you to arrange with the NSA a new intelligence system

plain: Harald Malmgren, who advised several US presidents, says that in 1974 President Gerald Ford's team, with the Ford aide Bill Seidman, asked him to set up a new intelligence system with the National Security Agency. Malmgren tells Michels he was given the job directly: "first of all, we want you to arrange with the NSA a new intelligence system." It comes up in an episode where he says he also handled UFO material.
